numinance.kinds.v1.ControlApproval.jsons.description:
ControlApproval is the approval a control requires. Policy enforces it at the release gate (and the plan gate where a
 stage declares one) whatever the StageRegistry contains; it only adds to the registry's gates. The loader refuses group
 or dual_control unless human is true.

dual_control.description:
dual_control is true when two distinct human principals, neither the author nor acting in the author's run, must
 approve; absent means false.

group.description:
group names the approver group the approver must belong to; membership comes from the org's identity provider,
 never from repository files.

human.description: human is true when a human principal must approve; absent means false.

numinance.kinds.v1.ControlApproval.jsons.title: Control Approval
